provenance: Created after initial worker handoff, before final architect-candidate validation. Not retroactively claimed as pre-issued matrix. Original OpenSpec MC-01..MC-06 and historical evidence remain immutable.

tests.given: Authorized admin and seller; existing trusted Pricing currency config.
tests.action: Read both reference APIs and compare against actual active configured codes and decimal places.
tests.expected: Exact same active codes, order and precision; IRR/JPY/KRW zero, USD/EUR two.
tests.forbiddenEffects: No invented currency or unauthorized scope.
tests.oracle: Raw config values (nonsecret), both HTTP responses, Pricing reference tests.

tests.given: Existing authorized synthetic offer and unchanged baseline facts/prices.
tests.action: Request unknown ISO-like code, inactive code and TMN using distinct operations.
tests.expected: Typed pricing.currency.invalid for unknown/inactive and canonical display-unit error for TMN.
tests.forbiddenEffects: Zero price/fact/outbox changes for each rejected case.
tests.oracle: Authenticated HTTP plus independent SQL per attempt; controlled inactive fixture.

tests.given: Real Pricing writer with registered reference containing no active currencies, and separately missing trusted market.
tests.action: Attempt default-currency write and query base rows with absent market context.
tests.expected: No write; typed currency error for inactive reference, market error for missing scope; no cross-market rows.
tests.forbiddenEffects: No fallback permission or cross-market disclosure; restore exact config/fixture if used.
tests.oracle: Existing Pricing integration provider / real PostgreSQL; exact restoration evidence.

tests.given: Real currency picker with blocked/failed reference endpoint or empty authorized list.
tests.action: Load editor; observe retry; try price mutation while unavailable; restore reference and retry.
tests.expected: Localized unavailable state, no price submission until ready, real reference recovers.
tests.forbiddenEffects: No silently invented options or prices, no loss of unrelated draft.
tests.oracle: Playwright request capture and actual authorized endpoint retry; distinguish failure injection from real persistence.

tests.given: One dedicated admin-created and one seller-created offer under valid permissions.
tests.action: Create with non-default currency from UI, then add a second currency via shared edit UI, reload.
tests.expected: One offer each, independent rows, exact selected amounts/revisions, primary store-default quote unchanged.
tests.forbiddenEffects: No partial false success, duplicate listing, or foreign-price substitution.
tests.oracle: Real browser UI for both roles; GET and PostgreSQL price/fact verification.

tests.given: Two sessions read same USD revision; IRR already exists.
tests.action: Win one USD change; attempt second stale USD write; separately edit IRR.
tests.expected: Stale USD typed conflict; IRR revision unchanged by USD; independent edits succeed on current revisions.
tests.forbiddenEffects: No stale mutation/fact/outbox, no cross-currency overwrite.
tests.oracle: Authenticated HTTP / real PostgreSQL before-after per revision and fact.

tests.given: Existing latest base authoring record Draft/Retired or an older effective record in same currency.
tests.action: Read editor authoring revision and write with exact selected revision; compare store quote.
tests.expected: Editor uses same latest authoring row as write CAS and actual status; effective price resolution remains independent; retired authoring follows existing create/overlap rules.
tests.forbiddenEffects: No hidden active status, no quote from draft/retired, no overlap or silent overwrite.
tests.oracle: Actual Pricing owner fixtures and queries, SQL, UI status/read-back; no invented lifecycle policy.

tests.given: Existing dirty USD draft with current and concurrent foreign-currency revisions.
tests.action: Simulate lost response and reload, then language/reload restoration while another session changes USD.
tests.expected: Concurrent different price blocks overwrite; committed identical intent reconciles; unrelated IRR change does not corrupt USD draft.
tests.forbiddenEffects: No automatic stale overwrite, no mixed currency and amount.
tests.oracle: Real browser/session storage plus backend HTTP/SQL; new reconcileDraft and draftVersion unit tests.

tests.given: Authorized offer; fresh operation ID and exact currency revision.
tests.action: Replay identical canonical monetary intent; reuse same ID with different amount or currency; concurrently replay same operation.
tests.expected: Identical replay returns same receipt; changed intent typed conflict; one durable fact and one actual mutation for identical operation.
tests.forbiddenEffects: No duplicate fact/price/outbox or replay cross-market/owner.
tests.oracle: Authenticated HTTP + actual SQL facts, price rows and outbox; compare exact operation ID.

tests.given: IRR=0, JPY=0 and USD/EUR=2 from actual reference.
tests.action: Attempt fractional zero-decimal amounts and excess FX scale in UI; save valid exact-scale amounts.
tests.expected: Invalid amounts produce localized error and no request; valid amounts persist exact canonical values.
tests.forbiddenEffects: No fractional IRR/JPY, no false response mismatch or unexpected rounding in editor.
tests.oracle: Playwright outgoing request count, GET, SQL, new validatePrice tests.

tests.given: Authorized synthetic IRR price and fresh operation ID.
tests.action: Submit 100000.75 directly using existing server rounding policy, then replay.
tests.expected: Price and durable NewAmount and receipt equal 100001; same operation has one fact.
tests.forbiddenEffects: No raw fractional history, no repeated mutation.
tests.oracle: Real HTTP, SQL price+fact values, history/readback, same operation replay.

tests.given: Actual DB active registry with fa-IR/en-US and any configured third locale.
tests.action: Use actual panel language selector, not only page.goto; inspect direction, format, pricing labels and currency edit; include comma-decimal locale if enabled.
tests.expected: Registry-driven active choices, locale/direction and localized labels; Persian digits and integer IRR; comma decimal preserved where configured.
tests.forbiddenEffects: No feature-local locale authority, no English leakage on tested translated pricing keys, no draft loss.
tests.oracle: Actual registry GET/DB read, admin and seller Playwright, request Accept-Language, i18n tests. If no third locale is configured, record absence and separately test ru locale in existing isolated unit fixture; do not claim live proof.

tests.given: Unsaved price draft and valid selected currency.
tests.action: Attempt currency switch before saving; then revert/save and switch.
tests.expected: Existing MessageBox gives localized warning and retains typed amount; after revert/save selected currency loads correct amount.
tests.forbiddenEffects: No silent discarded draft or accidental write.
tests.oracle: Playwright state and request count; no screenshots.

tests.given: Authorized existing offer with eligible warehouse and no stock position.
tests.action: Add warehouse and create/adjust physical stock with reason; reload.
tests.expected: Real position and stock quantity saved, appropriate owner controls and reason recorded.
tests.forbiddenEffects: No unauthorized or duplicate warehouse, no dropped pricing draft.
tests.oracle: Actual Playwright, Inventory owner GET/SQL, exact fixture cleanup.

tests.given: Seller outside owner scope or forbidden marketplace warehouse responsibility.
tests.action: Attempt price write and stock provisioning for another seller or unauthorized location.
tests.expected: Typed denial; no price, inventory or owner fact mutation.
tests.forbiddenEffects: No cross-owner disclosure or grant escalation.
tests.oracle: Actual authenticated negative HTTP/browser and SQL baseline comparison.

tests.given: Existing shared workspace admin and seller, representative variant with multiple attributes.
tests.action: Measure at 390x844 and desktop; check variant labels, header geometry, no market column, no excess placeholder copy.
tests.expected: No horizontal overflow or duplicate variant label, no market column, preserved shared design.
tests.forbiddenEffects: No Orders/other domain edits or new grid; no screenshots.
tests.oracle: Playwright DOM text, bounding boxes/scroll widths and existing design contract.

tests.given: Single default-currency offer with existing quote/cart/checkout path.
tests.action: Compare default list/quote/checkout behavior against prior contract before/after adding other currency; run existing affected backend and frontend regressions.
tests.expected: Primary price and default currency unchanged, all mandatory affected suites green.
tests.forbiddenEffects: No new offer per currency, no checkout or discount policy change, no unrelated regression.
tests.oracle: Existing real quote/cart/checkout paths and existing Offer/Pricing/Inventory tests, typecheck/build.

tests.given: Exact architect product candidate and existing architecture baseline.
tests.action: Run all applicable existing architecture guards, OpenSpec strict, evidence verifier and cleanup negative controls.
tests.expected: No new or Offer-owned violation; baseline identities unchanged; strict valid; checker rejects missing test/flipped fact/tampered evidence; exact cleanup.
tests.forbiddenEffects: No guard exception/baseline increase, no stale build or fabricated PASS.
tests.oracle: Raw guard output, actual source/build/DB identity, immutable additive matrix, checker and cleanup evidence.
